blocks.text: Grade 6 高频词汇 301–400
intrigue /in'triːg/ n. 阴谋, 复杂的事；v.i. 密谋, 私通；v.t. 激起...的兴趣, 用诡计取得
Her story has intrigued and inspired readers and historians ever since she was rescued.
中文语境：自从她获救以来，她的故事一直引起读者和历史学家的兴趣和启发
foreshadow /fɒː'ʃædəu/ v.t. 成为前兆, 预示
Her very last drawing was a black angel, which many people see as a foreshadowing of her death in 1954.
中文语境：她的最后一幅画是一位黑天使，许多人认为这是她 1954 年去世的伏笔
crop /krɒp/ n. 农作物, 产量, 平头；v.t. 收割, 修剪, 种植；v.i. 收获；[计] 裁剪

She produced some of her most famous paintings during the early 1940s, such as The Two Fridas, Self-Portrait with Cropped Hair , and The Wounded Table , and her art was featured in galleries from Mexico City to New York.
中文语境：她在 20 世纪 40 年代初创作了一些最著名的画作，例如《两个弗里达》、《剪短发的自画像》和《受伤的桌子》，她的艺术作品在从墨西哥城到纽约的画廊中展出
interpretation /in.təːpri'teiʃən/ n. 解释, 演出, 翻译；[计] 插值; 插值法; 解释
Kahlo's paintings are a unique mix of Mexican folk art, realistic portraits and still-life images, as well as gory interpretations of history and emotions.
中文语境：卡罗的画作独特地融合了墨西哥民间艺术、写实肖像和静物图像，以及对历史和情感的血腥诠释
remodel /riː'mɒdl/ v.t. 改造, 改型, 改变
She had an elevator installed in her home and had her car remodeled to accommodate her wheelchair.
中文语境：她在家中安装了电梯，并改装了汽车以容纳她的轮椅
fraternal /frə'təːnl/ adj. 兄弟的, 兄弟似的, 友爱的
After graduation, Maggie put her energies into a fraternal organization, the Independent Order of Saint Luke (I.O.S.L.), which she had joined when she was fourteen.
中文语境：毕业后，玛吉将她的精力投入到一个兄弟组织--圣路加独立修会（I.O.S.L.），她在十四岁时加入了该组织
trinket /'triŋkit/ n. 小件饰物, 无价值的琐碎东西, 小玩意儿

"I started from a most lowly place in life, from an alley rather than a street; I started with my arms filled with laundered clothes rather than armfuls of trinkets and toys, with feet that have been well acquainted with the rough and rugged road of life.
中文语境："我是从人生最卑微的地方开始的，是从巷子里开始的，而不是从大街上开始的；我开始的时候，怀里装满的是洗过的衣服，而不是一堆小饰品和玩具，双脚已经熟悉了生活的坎坷崎岖
folksy /'fəuksi/ adj. 和气的, 有民间风味的
He revolutionized jazz from a folksy group performance to an individual performance.
中文语境：他将爵士乐从民间团体表演彻底转变为个人表演
duet /djuː'et/ n. 二重奏
Armstrong and Oliver became well known for playing duets, so they decided to produce some jazz records together.
中文语境：阿姆斯特朗和奥利弗因演奏二重唱而闻名，因此他们决定一起制作一些爵士乐唱片
cornet /'kɒːnit/ n. 圆锥形纸袋, 短号；[医] 小助听筒
The musical style of jazz became popular around the world largely due to his talent as a cornet and trumpet player, his unique "scatting" singing style, and his strong and charming personality.
中文语境：爵士音乐风格风靡全球很大程度上得益于他作为短号和小号演奏家的天赋、独特的"散漫"演唱风格以及强烈而迷人的个性
authentic /ɒː'θentik/ adj. 可靠的, 可信的, 真正的；[法] 被认证的, 确认的, 可信的
Madden wanted to give "authentic black entertainment to a wealthy, whites-only audience."
中文语境：《Madden》希望为"富有的白人观众提供真正的黑人娱乐"
manufacture /.mænju'fæktʃə/ n. 产品, 制造；v.t. 制造, 假造；v.i. 制造
government passed a law outlawing the manufacture and sale of alcohol across the country.
中文语境：政府通过了一项法律，禁止在全国范围内生产和销售酒精
unproductive /.ʌnprə'dʌktiv/ adj. 不生产的, 无出产的, 不毛的；[经] 非生意性的, 浪费的
Their houses and belongings were always dirty; the dust blew into their lungs and made them sick; and their farms were unproductive.
中文语境：他们的房屋和财物总是脏兮兮的；灰尘吹进他们的肺部，使他们生病。他们的农场毫无生产力
topsoil /'tɒpsɒil/ n. 上层土, 表层土
First, in order to plant as much wheat as possible, they plowed over all of the natural prairie grasses that kept the topsoil in place.
中文语境：首先，为了种植尽可能多的小麦，他们犁掉了所有保持表土固定的天然草原草
blizzard /'blizəd/ n. 大风雪, 暴风雪
People called these strong dust storms "black blizzards," which could sometimes last for one or two days straight.
中文语境：人们将这些强烈的沙尘暴称为"黑色暴风雪"，有时会持续一两天
drought /draut/ n. 干旱, 缺乏
This drought would have been bad enough for farmers, but then strong winds picked up across the Great Plains.
中文语境：这场干旱对农民来说已经够糟糕的了，但随后大平原上刮起了强风
agricultural /.ægri'kʌltʃərəl/ adj. 农业的；[法] 农业的, 耕作的
Many headed all the way to California because they heard California had good agricultural jobs.
中文语境：许多人千里迢迢来到加州，因为他们听说加州有很好的农业工作
restore /ri'stɒː/ v.t. 回复, 恢复, 归还, 修补, 修复；v.t. 还原；v.i. 还原；[计] 还原; DOS外部命令:从备份盘中取回文件
A group of government employees planted trees throughout the region to restore root networks and keep the dirt stuck to the ground.
中文语境：一群政府雇员在整个地区种植树木，以恢复根系网络并保持泥土粘在地面上
nostalgia /nɒs'tældʒiə/ n. 乡愁, 向往过去, 怀旧之情；[医] 怀乡病
But after doing some "Nostalgia: Library" by Eugene Kim is licensed research to find books with black girls as the under CC BY 2.0.
中文语境：但在尤金·金（Eugene Kim）做了一些"怀旧：图书馆"之后，获得了在 CC BY 2.0 下寻找黑人女孩书籍的许可研究
cooperative /kəu'ɔpərətiv/ adj. 合作的；合作社的
According to Cooperative Children's Book Center, fewer than 10 percent of children's books released in 2015 had a black person as the main character.
中文语境：根据合作儿童图书中心的数据，2015年发行的儿童图书中，以黑人为主角的儿童图书不到10%
curriculum /kə'rikjuləm/ n. 课程；[医] 课程, 学程
Dias realized she probably wasn't the only black girl feeling like she couldn't relate to her school reading curriculum.
中文语境：迪亚斯意识到她可能不是唯一一个觉得自己无法适应学校阅读课程的黑人女孩
refine /ri'fain/ v.t. 精炼, 净化, 使优雅, 使精炼；v.i. 被精炼, 被净化
The Scientific Method was developed by the ancient Greeks and has been refined by scientists ever since.
中文语境：科学方法是由古希腊人开发的，此后一直被科学家们改进
hypothesis /hai'pɒθəsis/ n. 假设；[化] 假设
Construct a hypothesis
中文语境：构建一个假设
procedure /prə'siːdʒə/ n. 程序, 过程, 手续；[计] 规程; 过程
You will often be asked to present a list of materials and the steps of your experiment - this is called the procedure.
中文语境：您经常会被要求提供材料清单和实验步骤 - 这称为程序
strategic /strə'tiːdʒik/ adj. 战略的, 战略上的；[经] 战略的
A Strategic City
中文语境：战略城市
divert /dai'vəːt/ v.t. 转移, 使欢娱；v.i. 转移
An unexpected wind diverted the bomb's fall slightly; instead of landing on a bridge, it landed on a hospital 800 feet away.
中文语境：一阵意外的风使炸弹的下落方向发生了轻微的改变；它没有降落在桥上，而是降落在 800 英尺外的一家医院上
borrower /'bɒrəuə/ n. 借用人, 剽窃者；[经] 借款人, 借用人
Landowners sometimes sold sharecroppers seeds, shelter, and food for outrageous prices, slowly putting the borrowers into debt.
中文语境：土地所有者有时会以高得离谱的价格向佃农出售种子、住所和食品，慢慢地让借款人陷入债务
autobiography /.ɒːtəubai'ɒgrəfi/ n. 自传

In his autobiography, Holloway wrote that he and other former slaves "did not know how to be free" and that "white people did not know how to have a free colored person about them." His words reflect the difficulties of Reconstruction, a time period that came after the Civil War.
中文语境：霍洛威在自传中写道，他和其他前奴隶"不知道如何获得自由"，并且"白人不知道如何拥有一个自由的有色人种"。他的话反映了内战后重建时期的困难
reconstruction /.riːkən'strʌkʃən/ n. 改造, 再建；[医] 改建, 改造, 翻造

In his autobiography, Holloway wrote that he and other former slaves "did not know how to be free" and that "white people did not know how to have a free colored person about them." His words reflect the difficulties of Reconstruction, a time period that came after the Civil War.
中文语境：霍洛威在自传中写道，他和其他前奴隶"不知道如何获得自由"，并且"白人不知道如何拥有一个自由的有色人种"。他的话反映了内战后重建时期的困难
totalitarian /.təutæli'tєəriən/ adj. 极权主义的；n. 极权主义者
Qualities of a Totalitarian Country
中文语境：极权国家的品质
propaganda /.prɒpə'gændə/ n. 宣传, 宣传活动；[医] 宣传
Even though the Nazis did terrible things, many people were convinced by propaganda to support the government.
中文语境：尽管纳粹做了可怕的事情，许多人还是被宣传说服支持政府
inferior /in'fiəriə/ adj. 次等的, 较差的, 下方的, 下级的；n. 部下, 次品, 下标(符号)
The Nazis punished people who didn't agree with their racist ideas, and they murdered over 10 million people who they thought were inferior.
中文语境：纳粹惩罚那些不同意他们种族主义思想的人，他们杀害了超过1000万他们认为低等的人
adept /ə'dept/ adj. 熟练的, 老练的, 巧妙的；n. 能手, 内行
Asclepius was particularly adept at the healing arts, and I'm honored to have had a hand in sculpting the great god of medicine.
中文语境：阿斯克勒庇俄斯尤其擅长治疗艺术，我很荣幸能够参与雕刻这位伟大的医学之神
oracle /'ɒːrəkl/ n. 神谕, 神谕处, 预言
Seeing as you are an oracle - on top of all your other abilities - do you have any predictions about what, if anything, may ultimately cause your death?
中文语境：既然你是一位神谕者--除了你所有的其他能力之外--你对最终可能导致你死亡的因素（如果有的话）有任何预测吗？
traitor /'treitə/ n. 叛逆者, 叛国者；[法] 叛徒, 叛逆, 背信者
As a young man, he was left stranded in the wilderness by the traitor Acastus.
中文语境：年轻时，他被叛徒阿卡斯托斯遗弃在荒野中
highland /'hailənd/ n. 高地, 苏格兰高地
Growing up in a family of peasant farmers in the highlands of Kenya, Wangari Maathai (Wahn-GAHR-ee Mah-TIE) often fetched water from a nearby stream.
中文语境：旺加里·马塔伊 (Wahn-GAHR-ee Mah-TIE) 在肯尼亚高地的一个农民家庭长大，经常从附近的溪流取水
achievement /ə'tʃiːvmənt/ n. 完成, 成就, 功业
It was a rare achievement for a Kenyan girl to attend college in the United States.
中文语境：对于一名肯尼亚女孩来说，能够在美国上大学是一项罕见的成就
despicable /'despikəbl/ adj. 可鄙的, 卑劣的
It is reserved for only the most despicable people who have spent their lives as scoundrels, thieves, and murderers.
中文语境：它只为最卑鄙的人保留，他们一生都是无赖、小偷和杀人犯
tantalize /'tæntəlaiz/ v.t. 逗弄, 使干着急
Imagine how tantalizing that must be!
中文语境：想象一下那是多么诱人！
feat /fiːt/ n. 壮举, 功绩, 技艺表演；adj. 灵巧的, 合适的, 整洁的
People earn the right to spend eternity in the Elysian Fields through heroic feats and virtuous deeds on earth.
中文语境：人们通过在地球上的英雄事迹和美德行为，获得在极乐世界度过永恒的权利
virtuous /'vəːtʃuəs/ adj. 品德高尚的, 公正的, 贞洁的, 有效力的
People earn the right to spend eternity in the Elysian Fields through heroic feats and virtuous deeds on earth.
中文语境：人们通过在地球上的英雄事迹和美德行为，获得在极乐世界度过永恒的权利
certification /.səːtifi'keiʃən/ n. 证明；[经] 证明
Less than two years later, she had her private pilot's license, her instructor's certification and her commercial pilot's license.
中文语境：不到两年后，她获得了私人飞行员执照、教练证书和商业飞行员执照
dissipate /'disipeit/ v.t. 散失, 驱散, 浪费；v.i. 消散, 放荡
"I feel like everything I have on the ground dissipates in the air.
中文语境："我感觉地面上的一切都消散在空气中
aircraft /'єəkræft/ n. 航空器, 飞机；[机] 航空器
As far as what's next for Fox, she may move on to bigger aircraft one day.
中文语境：至于福克斯的下一步计划，她可能有一天会转向更大的飞机
socialism /'səuʃəlizm/ n. 社会主义, 社会主义运动
A socialist country is one that follows socialism, a system in which everyone is supposed to have an equal opportunity to benefit from a country's wealth.
中文语境：社会主义国家是一个遵循社会主义的国家，在这种制度下，每个人都应该有平等的机会从国家的财富中受益
escalate /'eskəleit/ v.i. 逐步扩大, 逐步升高, 逐步增强；v.t. 使逐步上升
Although the Cold War never did escalate from tension to real violence between the two countries, people in the United States worried that the Soviets might attack with a nuclear bomb.
中文语境：尽管冷战两国之间从未从紧张升级为真正的暴力，但美国民众担心苏联可能会用核弹发动袭击
government /'gʌvənmənt/ n. 政府, 内阁；[经] 政府, 政治, 政体
The United States government worked hard to teach as many people about the duck and cover drill as possible.
中文语境：美国政府努力向尽可能多的人传授鸭子和掩护演习的知识
kidnap /'kidnæp/ v.t. 绑架, 诱拐, 拐骗；[法] 拐带, 诱拐, 绑架
In 1966, an Arizona man named Ernesto Miranda was accused of kidnapping and assaulting a teenage girl.
中文语境：1966年，亚利桑那州一名名叫埃内斯托·米兰达的男子被指控绑架并殴打一名少女
confession /kən'feʃən/ n. 承认, 坦白, 招供；[法] 自白, 招供, 自认有罪
Later, during his trial, the prosecution used his confession as evidence to convict him.
中文语境：后来，在审判过程中，检方以他的供述作为定罪的证据
prosecution /.prɒsi'kjuːʃən/ n. 执行, 经营, 起诉
Later, during his trial, the prosecution used his confession as evidence to convict him.
中文语境：后来，在审判过程中，检方以他的供述作为定罪的证据
assault /ə'sɒːt/ n. 攻击, 袭击；v.t. 袭击, 攻击；v.i. 发动攻击
In 1966, an Arizona man named Ernesto Miranda was accused of kidnapping and assaulting a teenage girl.
中文语境：1966年，亚利桑那州一名名叫埃内斯托·米兰达的男子被指控绑架并殴打一名少女
peninsula /pi'ninsjulə/ n. 半岛, 突出的地方, 伊比利亚半岛
And Pluto's outermost moon, Hydra, is shaped like Michigan's lower peninsula.
中文语境：冥王星最外层的卫星九头蛇的形状像密歇根州的下半岛
marble /'mɑːbl/ n. 大理石, 石弹, 雕刻品；adj. 大理石的, 冷酷无情的, 有大理石花纹的
If Pluto were as big as a basketball, the typical object in this belt would be smaller than a marble.
中文语境：如果冥王星像篮球一样大，那么这条带中的典型物体将比弹珠小
newsworthy /'njuːzwəːði/ adj. 有报导价值的
For example, about 40% of reporters say they sometimes avoid writing a newsworthy story because it might say something bad about the company that owns their newspaper.
中文语境：例如，大约 40% 的记者表示，他们有时会避免撰写具有新闻价值的报道，因为这可能会说出报纸所属公司的坏话
newscaster /'njuːz.kɑːstə/ n. 新闻广播员, 新闻评论广播员
Similarly, the government monitored journalists and newscasters to make sure they did not give away any important information that might be useful to the enemy.
中文语境：同样，政府监视记者和新闻播音员，以确保他们不会泄露任何可能对敌人有用的重要信息
provoke /prə'vəuk/ v.t. 激怒, 惹起, 诱导；[法] 刺激, 煽动, 激怒
For example, while the United States cannot censor hate speech because it is protected as "free speech" under the First Amendment, it can censor threatening language that could provoke violence.
中文语境：例如，虽然美国无法审查仇恨言论，因为它受到第一修正案的"言论自由"保护，但它可以审查可能引发暴力的威胁性语言
turbulence /'təːbjuləns/ n. 混乱, 动荡, 骚乱, 紊流；[化] 湍流; 紊流
Thermals are responsible for those unsettling moments of bumpiness or "turbulence" we sometimes experience when flying in a regular airplane.
中文语境：热气流是造成我们在乘坐普通飞机飞行时有时会遇到的颠簸或"湍流"的令人不安的时刻的原因
buoyant /'bɒiənt/ adj. 有浮力的, 心情愉快的；[经] 降而复升的, 保持高价的, 遂之而升的
As warm air expands, it becomes less dense and more buoyant than the cool air around it.
中文语境：随着暖空气的膨胀，它的密度比周围的冷空气要小，浮力也更大
barometric /.bærəu'metrik/ adj. 气压的；[机] 气压的, 测定气压的
The observers would record eight different things, from local barometric pressure and temperature to details about atmospheric conditions, such as the wind, clouds, and rain or snowfall amounts.
中文语境：观察者将记录八种不同的事物，从当地的气压和温度到大气条件的详细信息，例如风、云、雨或降雪量
meteorology /.miːtiə'rɒlədʒi/ n. 气象学, 气象状态；[医] 气象学
For the first six months, Abbe was the only one who knew enough about meteorology to create forecasts.
中文语境：在最初的六个月里，阿贝是唯一一个对气象学有足够了解来进行预测的人
astronomical /.æstrə'nɒmikl/ adj. 天文学的, 庞大的
Abbe knew that atmospheric conditions such as clouds, haze, fog, and rain could affect astronomical observations.
中文语境：阿贝知道云、霾、雾和雨等大气条件可能会影响天文观测
update /ʌp'deit/ v.t. 更新, 使现代化；n. 更新；[计] 更新
In fact, its on-line national map (www.weather.gov/view/largemap.php) refreshes itself every five minutes to offer updated watches, warnings, and advisories.
中文语境：事实上，其在线国家地图（www.weather.gov/view/largemap.php）每五分钟刷新一次，以提供更新的监视、警告和建议
propose /prə'pəuz/ v.t. 计划, 打算, 建议, 提议, 求(婚)；v.i. 打算, 求婚
Abbe proposed setting up a network of weather observers around Cincinnati.
中文语境：阿贝提议在辛辛那提周围建立一个气象观测员网络
